# greet.py
def greet(name: str) -> str:
    return f"Hello, {name}!"

# test_greet.py
import contextlib
import io
import unittest

from greet import greet


class GreetTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_unicode_name(self):
        name = "Siobh\u00e1n N\u00ed Dh\u00faill"
        self.assertEqual(greet(name), "Hello, Siobh\u00e1n N\u00ed Dh\u00faill!")

    def test_decomposed_name_unchanged(self):
        name = "Siobha\u0301n"
        self.assertEqual(greet(name), "Hello, Siobha\u0301n!")
        self.assertIn(name, greet(name))

    def test_no_stdout(self):
        buf = io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
            greet("World")
        self.assertEqual(buf.getvalue(), "")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
